summary.text: Lauren Boebert is the Republican incumbent for Colorado's 4th Congressional District. A former natural gas industry worker and owner of a Rifle restaurant, she was first elected to Congress in 2020 from the 3rd District and won the 4th District seat in 2024. She advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary unopposed.

paragraphs.text: Boebert was born in Altamonte Springs, Florida, according to Ballotpedia.

Her official biography says she worked in the domestic energy sector as a natural gas product technician, GIS technician and pipeline integrity coordinator, and that she owned Shooter's Grill, a restaurant in Rifle, Colorado; it also says she had never held public office before her 2020 victory.

Boebert was first elected to the U.S. House in 2020 from Colorado's 3rd District, defeating incumbent Rep. Scott Tipton in the June 30, 2020 Republican primary and Democrat Diane Mitsch Bush in the general election, 51.4% to 45.2%.
She won re-election in 2022, defeating Democrat Adam Frisch 50.1% to 49.9% after winning the Republican primary over Don Coram, 66.0% to 34.0%.
Boebert represented the 3rd District from 2021 to 2025, then won the 4th District in November 2024 with 53.6% of the vote over Democrat Trisha Calvarese (42.0%).
Her committee assignments for 2025-2026 are Oversight and Government Reform and Natural Resources, where she is vice chair of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee.
She advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary with 92,651 votes, with no other candidate on the ballot.
Her official biography says she lives in Windsor, Colorado, and is the mother of four boys and a grandmother of one.
